en.sayed-ali-raza: Although Allāh gives time to the oppressor His catch would not spare him. Allāh watches him on the passage of his way and the position of that which suffocates the throats.

By Allāh in Whose power my life lies, these people (Mu‘āwiyah and his men) will overcome you not because they have a better right than you but because of their hastening towards the wrong with their leader and your slowness about my right (to be followed).
People are afraid of the oppression of their rulers while I fear the oppression of my subjects.
